The Centre has proposed increasing the number of treatment packages reserved exclusively for government hospitals under Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) from 23 to 112.
The proposed list includes C-sections, hysterectomies, medical termination of pregnancy, circumcision, piles surgery and removal of breast lumps. It also covers common conditions such as severe anaemia, urinary tract infections and kidney stone-related pain.
